privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: The Academy ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our training log synchronization service.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.description: We collect information that you provide directly to us and information automatically collected when you use our service:

items.account: Account information (name, email address, profile picture from Google)
items.strava: Strava activity data (workouts, runs, distances, times, heart rate data)
items.google: Google Sheets access for your training spreadsheet

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.description: We use the collected information to:

items.sync: Synchronize your Strava activities with your Google Sheets training plan
items.automation: Provide automated daily synchronization if enabled
items.notifications: Send email notifications about synchronization results

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.description: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Your OAuth tokens are encrypted before storage.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: Our service integrates with third-party services that have their own privacy policies:
thirdParty.google: We access your Google account solely to read and update your specified training spreadsheet.
thirdParty.strava: We access your Strava account to retrieve your activity data for synchronization.

items.deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.description: We retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to provide you with our service. Activity logs are retained for 90 days. You can delete your account at any time, which will remove all associated data.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date.

terms.introduction: Welcome to The Academy. These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of our training log synchronization service. By using our service, you agree to be bound by these Terms.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.description: By accessing or using The Academy, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you disagree with any part of these terms, you may not access the service.

serviceDescription.title: Service Description
serviceDescription.description: The Academy provides a service that:

items.sync: Synchronizes your Strava activities with your Google Sheets training plan
items.notifications: Sends email notifications about synchronization results

userAccounts.title: User Accounts
userAccounts.description: To use our service, you must:

items.security: Maintain the security of your account
items.responsibility: Be responsible for all activities under your account
items.authorization: Have the right to grant us access to your Google and Strava accounts

items.compliance: You must comply with their respective terms of service

termination.description: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason, including breach of these Terms. You may delete your account at any time through the service interface.
